budget_bands.note: Smallest in-stock sizes that still complete a 2–3 step routine. A two-step cleanse + moisturise starts at Rs 300.

budget_bands.label: Everyday
budget_bands.note: Daily/personal sizes around the mid-price of each routine step. A typical mid-catalog face routine totals about Rs 1280. A typical mid-catalog body routine totals about Rs 1770.

budget_bands.label: Generous
